Comedian Samay Raina's YouTube show vastly outperforms Netflix version

Comedian Samay Raina's show 'India's Got Latent' has seen a significant disparity in viewership between YouTube and Netflix. The episodes released on YouTube have garnered over 61 million views, while the same episodes on Netflix have not reached 1 million views. This indicates a substantial difference in audience engagement across the two platforms for Raina's content.
